findings.description: Jakub Wojtczak died on 19 March 1997 in Waterbury, New Haven County, Connecticut, according to the Connecticut death index, which indexes him as Frank J Wojtczak, a married retired pattern maker residing in Naugatuck, born 2 December 1917 in Connecticut, with a spouse named Helen.

details.place: Waterbury, New Haven, Connecticut, United States
